# Feature Request

## Summary

Provide a short and clear description of the feature.

---

## Problem Statement

Describe the problem or limitation you are trying to solve.

Example:

> As a developer, I want ..., so that ...

---

## Proposed Solution

Describe your proposed solution in as much detail as possible.

Include:

- New functionality
- Expected behaviour
- User experience
- API changes (if applicable)

---

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or approaches you have considered.

---

## Use Cases

Explain how this feature would benefit users.

Example scenarios:

- Enterprise deployment
- AI workflows
- Developers
- System administrators
- Research
- Documentation

---

## Impact

Which areas of the project would be affected?

- [ ] Frontend
- [ ] Backend
- [ ] API
- [ ] Authentication
- [ ] AI Services
- [ ] Agent Framework
- [ ] RAG Pipeline
- [ ] Database
- [ ] Infrastructure
- [ ] Docker
- [ ] Kubernetes
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] CI/CD
- [ ] Other

---

## Additional Information

Include:

- Mock-ups
- Screenshots
- API examples
- References
- Research links

---

## Checklist

Before submitting, please confirm:

- [ ] I searched existing feature requests.
- [ ] This feature aligns with the project's goals.
- [ ] I have described the problem clearly.
- [ ] I have provided a proposed solution.
- [ ] I understand that feature requests are evaluated based on project priorities.
